versions.changelog:
agent-skills-collector v1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Collects relevant AI Skills for specified agent business types from SkillHub in real time and exports as Excel.
- Supports interactive selection of data sources.
- Includes direct search and script-based usage methods.
- Predefined agent types and keywords provided for convenience.
- Output Excel file includes detailed skill attributes.
- Advises API usage best practices and data de-duplication.
